task.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable full-bleed material texture, not a finished card. Primary request: a flat orthographic sheet of muted antique champagne gold, fine hammered grain and subtle aged patina. Neutral diffuse frontal lighting and uniform brightness; restrained desaturated gold, low contrast. No jewels, no bevel, no frame, no symbol, no text, no object, no cast shadow, no vignette, no perspective. Portrait 2:3. Fill every pixel with metal; intended to be clipped into thin vector frame bands by a compositor.
